task_name: Girdermark - Technical data-sheet and bin-label library
client_brief:
Technical sheets and bin labels from two separate legacy PDFs

Production request: Girdermark Components

Scope
1. Technical part data sheet: 18 named exports. The component photograph matches this part. Dimensions preserve their units.
2. Part bin label: 18 named exports. The part identifier is readable at rack distance. The label does not substitute a similar part.

Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Permission restrictions in the owner's notes take precedence over inclusion in a source table.

Use the attached brand identity and the source files listed in the asset manifest. The output register defines exact filenames, pages, sizes and record bindings. Supporting previews are welcome but cannot replace those files.

brand_identity.sector: A B2B distributor of OEM elevator and electrical replacement components, sold to service technicians, maintenance supervisors and electrical contractors.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Cleveland, Ohio; canonical context for the repeat-client series.
brand_identity.about: Girdermark Components is the repeat client for this benchmark series. The canonical client context is Cleveland, Ohio, and this commission covers phase 2: data-sheet and bin-label library.
brand_identity.audience: Working buyers aged thirty five to sixty who have specified this class of part for twenty years and judge a supplier by whether the picture and the numbers match.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Parts from 400 to 9,000 dollars. A flat, even, technical register: one neutral photographic ground, the whole part in frame, generous spec setting, prices plain in the run of the page. Never bright consumer tool styling and never dark cinematic hero work. The bin label answers to a picker at arm's length, so it is bigger, blunter and carries less.
brand_identity.typography: A technical, legible system: a neutral grotesque sans for part numbers, spec tables and labels where clarity at small size and at arm's length is everything, with a plain companion for running copy. No decorative or humanist warmth. Note that no chosen face can reach the printer's sheet or the label house's label, which keep their existing typography.
brand_identity.voice: Blunt, factual and useful. No marketing adjectives, no styling in the words. Example line the brand would write: "Sixteen active parts this season. Specs, codes and prices are exactly as our system holds them."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The division owns none of its own artwork. The spec sheet and the bin label exist only as the flat press PDFs the printer and the label house return. The house mark was lost in an office move and survives only in the printed sheet header and cast into an aluminium nameplate riveted to an old traction machine in the back, photographed for reference. Part photography was shot in house on the bench over several months and does not match.
brand_identity.values: Accuracy above all: the picture and the spec must agree, values are never reworded to fit, and anything that will not fit is raised before it prints.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Reconcile records before merge and prove page, row, name, and amount completeness from the delivered artifacts.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export and the separately listed editable source.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
